preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the ShibZilla contract.
The target contract must have a non-zero native currency (BNB) balance.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `clearStuckBalance_sender` function with `amountPercentage` set to 100. This will transfer 100% of the contract's native currency (BNB) balance to the owner's address.
